title: Work Smarter with, Snowflake CoWork, Your Personal Work Agent

segments.text: Today our demo will focus on a fictional
business snow music which manages live
tour operations and a hightra fan
application.
I will demo as the VP of sales first
showing how a business leader starts the
day. Data everywhere action items buried
in unread emails and hundreds of Slack
messages. The information is everywhere
and another static dashboard isn't going
to cut it. This is where Snowflake
Co-work your personal work agent comes
in. Co-work brings together knowledge
into one trusted enterprise agent, makes
recommendations, and takes actions.
Let's get started. I will begin morning
triage by prompting co-work.
What do I need to know? Notice that
there are no complex menus or agent
pickers here. Exactly how a business
user wants to do it. I simply ask my
question and it automatically routes the
request based on my context.
Soft coork is analyzing data across many
source tables, emails, Slack
conversations, and more. It learns my
behavior over time to deliver highly
personalized responses, prioritizing
what actually matters. Look at this
update. Till it specifically for me.
Co-work provides the critical
information I should know about. While
prompting this live is incredibly easy,
I can also turn this into an automated
flow by setting up a scheduled
automation. Here I'm showing how co-work
automations are set up. This analysis
will be delivered straight into my inbox
first thing in the morning, completely
eliminating manual triage, allowing me
to start taking actions immediately.
Let's dig into something I saw in my
morning update. I noticed a surge in VIP
fan upgrades at the Miami show. My
regional manager has already started
looking into this and shared a live
interactive dashboard with me using
artifacts. Artifacts now include
publishable dashboards with governed
views of live data. It turns one-off
dashboards into reusable insights so
teams can ask questions and get insights
building on each other's work. I can
query this artifact directly and ask
what is driving the VIP search in Miami.
Safe co answers in line instantly with a
grounded chart. Now I need to loop in
our local field team. To do so, I'll
simply send a Slack message to the team
with this link. And just like that, the
message is directly shared via Slack
using our MCP connectors to execute this
task. I've diagnosed the surge,
collaborated with my team, and looped in
field reps without switching tools, all
in one place from cowork. This VIP surge
in Miami spans multiple data sources,
including service, social sentiment,
ticket resale, and venue wait times,
requiring deeper exploration. To solve
this, I have enabled deep research in my
prompt to execute multiplestep reasoning
across data and web sources in one shot.
Without deep research, this would take
multiple analysts and days of manual
work. Because it takes 10 to 15 minutes
to fully execute, I've pre-run it here.
Deep Research automatically spins up
four parallel sub aents to tackle
different data sets at once, providing
incredibly thorough research. It
delivered a synthesized briefing with
built-in citations.
Now I understand what happened to my
business and exactly why and what to do
next.
Next, I have a very important meeting
coming up. Usually preparing for this
means chasing a bid across platforms.
Instead, I'll simply ask Cohort, prepare
me for my next meeting with three most
important talking points.
Co securely scans meeting notes, Slack
conversations, emails, and other sources
to deliver a set of talking points. Now,
I'm completely prepared for my meeting.
To make this repeatable process, I will
use the follow-up prompt. Please prepare
me for this meeting every Tuesday at
10:00 a.m. This automation will run
every week right before my meeting.
Co-work is personalized for me operating
as a true productivity partner. Now I'm
going to ask a question that spans
across multiple data sets and artifacts
with cities had strong fan engagement
but underperformed on merch in the
quarter. With Cortex Sense working under
the hood, the context layer builds
understanding across every artifact and
data set from my organization. The more
data and context the data flows through
Snowflake, the richer the context
becomes in every shared asset makes the
model smarter. Cortex Sense is pulling
from every artifact, including fan
engagement and the business artifact my
GM shared earlier. Neither source alone
could answer this question. Cortex Sense
automatically builds that understanding
for you. No manual mapping, no waiting
on the data team. Look at that. It
combined fan engagement data from one
artifact with merch revenue from another
without me telling it where to look. And
because work doesn't stop when you leave
your desk, this entire experience
extends to a seamless mobile experience,
enabling you to securely ask questions
and take action on your data and
workflows from anywhere on the go. To
wrap up, Soulflake Co-work is now a
personal work agent for every business
user. It understands your data and your
work from day one. Answers the hardest
why questions with cited research and
runs the work on demand on schedule and
across the tools your business already
uses. All inside Soulflick governance
perimeter
